## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-juan early-to-mid-Qīng *Vajracchedikā* structural-doctrinal commentary by the monk Língyào Quánzhāng 靈耀全彰. The work opens (No. 493-A) with a fully-developed Tiāntái-style hierarchical *kēpàn* outline — *yī zǒngtí; èr biéwén (sān): yī xùfēn (èr): yī tōngxù (rúshì), èr biéxù (ěrshí); èr zhèngzōng …* 一總題 / 二別文(三) / 一序分(二) / 一通序(如是) / 二別序(爾時) / 二正宗 — making the volume primarily an outline and structural-tendency commentary rather than a verse-by-verse exposition. The title's *bùzhǐ* 部旨 ("categorical / sectional tendency") signals the format: a *macro-structural reading* identifying the *zhǐ* (tendency, doctrinal aim) of each major section of the sūtra, in the manner of Tiāntái *xuányì* / *wénjù* meta-commentary. Preserved as X25 no. 493. The text bears no internal date; *notBefore* / *notAfter* set conservatively to the Qīng era prior to publication (1644–1722). Catalog dynasty 清.

**Abstract**

The work is one of the more formally rigorous Tiāntái-school *Vajracchedikā* commentaries of the Qīng, distinct in genre from the lay-Buddhist devotional commentaries (e.g. [KR6c0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0078)), the Chán-flavored personal teachings (e.g. [KR6c0061](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0061), [KR6c0062](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0062)), and the multi-author compendia (e.g. [KR6c0079](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0079)). Língyào's *bùzhǐ* method places each phrase of the sūtra into a deeply nested hierarchical outline, with brief *zhǐyào* commentary at each terminal node. The 32-section Liáng Zhāomíng division is *not* used; instead the work follows the older Tiāntái 序分 / 正宗 / 流通 tripartite frame, sub-divided to several levels of nesting. This structural rigor and the avoidance of Chán-anecdotal apparatus mark Língyào as standing in the line of strict Tiāntái scholastic recovery characteristic of mid-Qīng monastic teaching.
